trips.name: Huntsville – Fairy Lake – Peninsula Lake – North Portage
trips.note: S.S. Algonquin: Huntsville station dock 8.00 a.m. (from train 47) through Fairy and Peninsula Lakes to North Portage, for the Portage Flyer. Huntsville and Lake of Bays Navigation Co., daily except Sunday: a MODEL day. Printed in the 1948 Official Guide (CN Table 126): Huntsville dock 8.00 a.m. and 3.25 p.m., Dorset 12.45 p.m. and 8.00 p.m.; Dorset 6.30 a.m., Huntsville 11.40 a.m. The calls and the rest of the pattern from the company's 1942 summer timetable; the second sailing from Dorset and every other time estimated. Most landings are flag calls (stop on arrangement). Eastern Standard Time, shown here three hours earlier on the Pacific clock.
